title: Script Progress: access.json
description: The Access Map graph: which tasks touch which resources. Written by access(); the reporter keeps every task node plus the 150 most recently seen resource nodes.

nodes.description: Every script and resource in the map. Task nodes are always kept; resource nodes are dropped least-recently-seen first.

edges.description: One link per task/resource/mode combination. An edge whose endpoints are no longer in nodes is dropped.

accessNode.description: One node of the map: a script, or something a script touches.

id.description: Unique node id. Scripts are 'task:<task name>'; resources are '<type>:<name>', e.g. 'table:sales.orders'.

type.description: task = one of your scripts; file = a file on disk; table = a database table or view; api = a service or endpoint; other = anything else. The type sets the node color and its legend group.

label.description: Text drawn next to the node. For a task this is the task name; for a resource it is the name passed to access().

lastSeen.description: ISO timestamp of the last time this node was touched. Used by scriptProgress.accessMap.timeWindowDays and to decide which resources to drop when over the node cap.

accessEdge.description: One link from a task to a resource, in one direction.

from.description: Id of the task node that did the touching.

to.description: Id of the resource node that was touched.

mode.description: read = the script read the resource (drawn dashed); write = the script wrote to it (drawn solid).

count.description: How many times this exact link has been recorded. Line width grows with the count.

lastSeen.description: ISO timestamp of the most recent time this link was recorded.
